title: Turn a complete fixed-service prediction bound into a physically specified decoder
statement: For the same fixed service, half-diamond channel error<=eta controls EVERY CPTP decoder loss by eta. A certified model-optimal decoder with slack zeta has ideal regret<=2eta+zeta.
